Laura — thanks for the context. Finance perspective:

- 50/50 over 14 days is an acceptable short-term staging for strategic accounts, provided we get a signed MOU that names the payer and confirms acceptance of our payment T&Cs. We prefer a non-refundable first tranche to reduce churn risk.
- For EU VAT: include explicit note “reverse charge applies — VAT to be accounted for by the recipient under Art. 44-59 VAT directive” and list net amount with 0% VAT line. That should satisfy most tax teams; keep our legal tax disclaimer short.
- If Helios cannot sign, we should move to a credit hold on the account and escalate to collections on Day 22. Collections team (AcmeCollections) should be pre-notified to stand by.

Rishi — tagging you for legal: any concerns about referencing reverse-charge language on our invoice and linking to an MOU for staged payments? Also confirm whether a non-refundable first tranche is contractually allowed under the current SOW.

Jonas
Head of AR Operations
